thread:
olivia (cs): Hey team — CS needs temporary Raygun access for 3 contractors to triage a high-volume customer error. Can Eng/Sec confirm any immediate redaction or permission blockers?

kevin (eng): Which fields would we be sending to Raygun? stack traces + metadata?

olivia (cs): Stack traces, request id, customer id, and a short user identifier we currently log as `user_email` in some handlers. We can change what we send if needed.

maria (eng-security): Heads up — `user_email` is PII. We can't forward raw email to third-party error trackers without an approved DPIA/contract. 

maria (eng-security): Quick suggestions: 1) remove/send hashed user identifier instead of email; 2) sample requests (no full session dumps); 3) set retention to 30d and disable any session replay.

kevin (eng): Agree on hashing. Example change:
```
- metadata.user_email = user.email
+ metadata.user_id_hash = sha256(user.email)
```
That keeps triageability without exposing email.

jamal (infra): Also make sure okta group provisioning is used for access. We should create an `okta_raygun_readonly` group and add the contractors to it. No write/admin perms.

ruth (legal): We'll need a quick addendum to the vendor contract confirming no PII storage and 30d retention. I can draft a one-pager.

olivia (cs): Cool. Is there any logging pattern we need to change besides swapping email for hash? We sometimes include `request.headers` which can contain auth tokens.

maria (eng-security): Don't send full headers. Strip `authorization` and `cookie`. Only send minimal headers: `x-request-id`, `user-agent` (optional). Example redaction snippet: 
```
const safeHeaders = pick(headers, ['x-request-id', 'user-agent'])
// remove cookies/auth tokens
```

kevin (eng): I'll put a small middleware to sanitize before errors are reported. Will target a PR today and tag @maria for review.

olivia (cs): For access duration, can we limit contractors to 30 days?

jamal (infra): Yes — we can set the Okta group with a 30-day expiry and audit it. Also enable SSO-mfa requirement.

maria (eng-security): One more: enable IP allowlist for the Raygun project to only accept calls from our infra IP ranges (and the support team's outbound proxy). Prevent accidental client-side ingestion.

olivia (cs): Sounds good. Next steps summary?

kevin (eng): 1) I'll open PR to hash email + strip headers. 2) jamal to create okta_raygun_readonly with 30d expiry and MFA. 3) ruth to draft vendor addendum. 4) maria to approve redaction PR and confirm IP allowlist config.

ruth (legal): I'll aim to send a draft by EOD tomorrow.

maria (eng-security): If all that lands, security sign-off for read-only triage access. No session replay, no PII keys, 30d retention, Okta group only.

olivia (cs): Thanks all — adding contractors to the ticket and pinging once PR and okta group are live. :thumbsup: :lock:

raygun-bot: New project created: "redwood-cs-raygun-triage" — admin actions restricted.
